evidence: We are Community Cornerstone, serving individuals with disabilities in Southern Humboldt and Northern Mendocino Counties since 1985.
Facilities are ADA-compliant to ensure accessibility.
The venue is accessible via car and has wheelchair-accessible front and backyard entrances, though bathrooms and rear exits are not accessible.
Our mission is to enrich community life through accessible recreation and inclusive programming.
The organization emphasizes patient-centered care and aims to improve health outcomes through accessible pharmacy services.
